parameters.$filter: ID ne @{triggerOutputs()?['body/ID']} and TaskStart ge '@{outputs('Later_anchor')}' and TaskStart lt '@{addDays(convertToUtc(concat(convertFromUtc(body('Get_item_started')?['TaskStart'], 'India Standard Time', 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'T00:00:00'), 'India Standard Time'), 1)}'

Later_note.inputs: @concat(body('Get_item_started')?['Title'], ': now ', convertFromUtc(outputs('New_start'), 'India Standard Time', 'HH:mm'), ' → ', convertFromUtc(outputs('New_end_later'), 'India Standard Time', 'HH:mm'), '. ', if(empty(variables('LaterMoved')), 'Nothing else moves.', concat('Moved ', join(variables('LaterMoved'), ', '), ' by ', string(div(add(outputs('Later_delta_sec'), 30), 60)), ' min.')))

Stale_note.inputs: @concat(body('Get_item_started')?['Title'], ' changed since this card (now ', convertFromUtc(body('Get_item_started')?['TaskStart'], 'India Standard Time', 'HH:mm'), ' → ', convertFromUtc(body('Get_item_started')?['TaskEnd'], 'India Standard Time', 'HH:mm'), '). Nothing moved; use its newer card.')

parameters.$filter: TaskStart gt '@{body('Get_item_start')?['TaskStart']}' and TaskStart lt '@{convertToUtc(concat(convertFromUtc(body('Get_item_start')?['TaskStart'], 'India Standard Time', 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'T23:59:59'), 'India Standard Time')}' and TaskStatus eq 'planned'

body.text: @{if(empty(body('Get_item_end')?['TaskActualStart']), concat(convertFromUtc(body('Get_item_end')?['TaskStart'], 'India Standard Time', 'HH:mm'), ' – ', convertFromUtc(body('Get_item_end')?['TaskEnd'], 'India Standard Time', 'HH:mm'), ' · ', string(div(add(sub(ticks(body('Get_item_end')?['TaskEnd']), ticks(body('Get_item_end')?['TaskStart'])), 300000000), 600000000)), ' min'), concat('Started ', convertFromUtc(coalesce(body('Get_item_end')?['TaskActualStart'], body('Get_item_end')?['TaskStart']), 'India Standard Time', 'HH:mm'), ' · ran ', string(div(add(sub(ticks(utcNow()), ticks(coalesce(body('Get_item_end')?['TaskActualStart'], body('Get_item_end')?['TaskStart']))), 300000000), 600000000)), ' min'))}

parameters.body/body/updateMessage: Got it, saved to Day Planner.

parameters.$filter: ID ne @{triggerOutputs()?['body/ID']} and TaskStart ge '@{body('Get_item_pressed')?['TaskEnd']}' and TaskStart lt '@{addDays(convertToUtc(concat(convertFromUtc(body('Get_item_pressed')?['TaskStart'], 'India Standard Time', 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'T00:00:00'), 'India Standard Time'), 1)}'

Moved_note.inputs: @concat(body('Get_item_pressed')?['Title'], ': ends at ', convertFromUtc(outputs('New_end'), 'India Standard Time', 'HH:mm'), '. ', if(empty(variables('Moved')), 'Nothing else moves.', concat('Moved ', join(variables('Moved'), ', '), ' by ', string(div(add(outputs('Delta_sec'), 30), 60)), ' min.')))

Stale_stop_note.inputs: @if(equals(body('Get_item_pressed')?['TaskStatus']?['Value'], 'planned'), concat(body('Get_item_pressed')?['Title'], ' changed since this card (now ', convertFromUtc(body('Get_item_pressed')?['TaskStart'], 'India Standard Time', 'HH:mm'), ' → ', convertFromUtc(body('Get_item_pressed')?['TaskEnd'], 'India Standard Time', 'HH:mm'), '). Nothing moved; use its newer card.'), concat(body('Get_item_pressed')?['Title'], ' is already ', coalesce(body('Get_item_pressed')?['TaskStatus']?['Value'], 'changed'), '. Nothing changed.'))
